about_the_game:
Tower Up – Build your way to the top!

Tower Up is a physics-based building game where your goal is simple: reach the top. Place blocks carefully, balance unstable shapes, and climb higher and higher without everything falling apart beneath you. The journey takes you up one massive vertical map— with multiple stages of increasing difficulty. One wrong move, and it could all come crashing down.

🧱 How it works:

  • Physics-based block placement – No snapping, no grids. Just you, gravity, and your sense of balance.

  • Strategic stacking – Different block shapes and sizes make every placement a puzzle.

  • One goal – Reach the top using only your skill and creativity.

🧪 What’s in the demo?

The demo includes the first 3 stages of the map, giving you a taste of the core gameplay and climbing challenge. Each stage brings you higher up the tower and tests your precision and problem-solving in new ways.

Multiplayer is planned for the full release, but this demo is single-player only.


"Man proposes..."

...God disposes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad Core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or similar. 3 Gb VRAM.
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 or similar. 8 Gb VRAM.
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
